RA-2DPCA provenance and comparison contract
=========================================
Paper: Z. Tan and H. Yang, Reweighted angle two-dimensional principal
component analysis for feature extraction, Pattern Recognition 168 (2025),
111817. DOI: 10.1016/j.patcog.2025.111817.
Author repository: https://github.com/cqtzx/RA2DPCA
Pinned commit: 84d54472cc5b615611b605f330df2501d00401d0
Algorithm reference: RA_2DPCA/funs.R, RA_2DPCA and RE_RA_2DPCA functions.
Example reference: RA_2DPCA/RE.R.
The author README identifies the repository with the paper and identifies
the original implementation as R. No LICENSE file was present in the
inspected tree. This package does not redistribute the author's source or
datasets. NB_RA2DPCA.m independently implements the documented recurrence.

Preserved algorithm choices
---------------------------
* Right projection initialized to the first k columns of the identity.
* For each centered matrix row z, d=||z-zVV'||_2 and
  weight=max(0,lambda-d/gamma)/(||z||_2*d+0.0001).
* Accumulate sum(weight*z'*z) and retain the k leading eigenvectors.
* Stop when abs(f_new-f_old)/f_new <= 1e-4, where f is the sum of sample
  Frobenius residual norms; f_old starts at 1; at most 100 updates.
* By default subtract the mean training image, matching RE_RA_2DPCA.
* The author example uses lambda=1 and gamma=the raw training array's
  empirical 90th percentile. This is data-scale dependent. An experiment
  using a development-selected gamma must identify that selection protocol.

Explicit numerical/engineering differences
-----------------------------------------
* MATLAB eig replaces R eigen. Eigenvector signs do not affect projectors.
  Repeated eigenvalues can yield different bases/subspaces in finite
  precision; this is not bitwise equivalence to the R implementation.
* Row calculations are vectorized and covariance is symmetrized.
* Input checks reject nonpositive gamma instead of silently changing it.
* Exact zero total residual receives a dedicated status because the
  author's relative-change expression has a zero denominator.
* Optional time/iteration limits are explicitly recorded.
* V2 logs training-only positive-row-weight fractions, covariance norm/rank,
  and initial/final weight diagnostics. This does not change a nondegenerate
  recurrence. If all weights or the covariance are exactly zero, the prior
  basis is retained and the fit is labelled zero_weight_degenerate instead
  of diagonalizing an all-zero covariance and claiming a stable arbitrary
  direction. No parameter or scale is silently changed to rescue that fit.
* No optimality/stationarity claim is attached to the author's relative-
  residual stopping rule.

Metric and fairness requirements
-------------------------------
This is a one-sided method with p*k feature entries. Do not compare its
integer k directly with both ranks r,c of a bilateral method. Report actual
feature dimension and, if needed, performance against representation size.
Reconstruction: mu + (X-mu)*V*V'.
Features: reshape((X-mu)*V,[],1).
Classification standardization is learned from the gallery only.
Do not feed the returned identity U into a bilateral subspace-error metric;
bilateral Esub is not applicable to this external baseline. Evaluate common
NRE and classification metrics, with all methods' native mean handling.

BA2DPCA status
--------------
The original author's university page lists the paper, but no BA2DPCA code
link was present at that entry. No verified official implementation or
public source-faithful implementation was located. This package must not
label a generic angular/IRLS routine as BA2DPCA. The external comparison
remains incomplete until a verified second baseline is integrated.
